The tie at 89

An Immense World vs. Rubicon All at 89 pts

Three pairs finished level: Rubicon and An Immense World on 89, The Black Count and The Man in the High Castle on 69, and Mayflower and Say Nothing on 68. The methodology calls for a Condorcet head-to-head first: ignore the rest of the ballot and ask how each voter ranked the two against one another.

All three pairs separated, and all three by the same 5–4 margin. Rubicon beat An Immense World and takes the book. The Black Count beat The Man in the High Castle for sixth, and Mayflower beat Say Nothing for eighth. No fall-through to first-place votes was needed.

Notes

A debut winner. Rubicon had never been polled before and went straight to the top, with three first-place votes — the most of any book.

The new arrivals did well. Five books were on the ballot for the first time; Rubicon won and Undaunted Courage finished third on 75.

The River of Doubt is relegated after twenty-four polls, finishing thirteenth on 52 despite a first-place vote.

Methodology

Borda count with 14 candidates: 1st place = 14 points, last place = 1 point. 9 forced-rank ballots collected via survey. Ties resolve per the club's Polling Methodology memo (formalized after the February 2026 tie): Condorcet head-to-head first, then first-place votes if pairwise cannot separate the books. This round produced 3 ties: 89 points, resolved by condorcet; 69 points, resolved by condorcet; 68 points, resolved by condorcet.
